title: Ultimate Victoria Pedicab Tour - 3 hrs 4-8 People
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Maximum weight is 600 lbs (270 kg) total per 2 people or a total of 1200lbs (540 kg) per 4 people.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Looking for the ultimate way to experience Victoria while sitting back and relaxing? Our 3-Hour Ultimate Victoria Pedicab Tour covers it all, giving you a comprehensive introduction to the city's history, culture, architecture, and natural beauty. Your knowledgeable local guide will share fascinating stories and local insights as you enjoy a fun and comfortable private tour.

Please note: On the 8:30 PM departure, the castle grounds are closed for the evening. Instead, we will show you some of Victoria's most iconic and historic cathedrals.

Perfect for cruise ship guests, day visitors, families, and anyone wanting to make the most of their time in Victoria, this tour provides an unforgettable and personalized sightseeing experience. 

For cruise ship passengers, we guarantee a timely return to the cruise terminal, allowing you to explore with confidence and peace of mind.
